title: A.10 auth cache discovery
command: Get-ChildItem -Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\PowerAppsCli" -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime; Get-ChildItem -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.config" -Recurse -Filter "*token*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime
